warrior.title: Warrior
warrior.description: Melee combat: armour, weapons and endurance.

knight.title: Knight
knight.description: An armoured wall. Knights soak up hits with damage and projectile resistance, armour toughness and stun armour, and hit back with greatswords. Shield and Fortify let them shrug off fights other classes would run from, Impact Guard blocks almost anything and Endurance keeps them swinging through hits. Key abilities: Shield, Fortify, Impact Guard, Endurance.
knight.extra_description: Opens the Knight tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

samurai.title: Samurai
samurai.description: A disciplined duellist who lives on timing. Every katana strike hits harder and cuts through armour, every perfect parry refills stamina and reflects damage, and heavy impacts stagger enemies. A Stance channels fire, wind, water or earth, Flaming Strike sets the blade alight, and Parrying and Technician reward perfect timing. Key abilities: Stance, Flaming Strike, Blitz, Surprise Attack, Myriad Blades Convergence, Parrying, Technician.
samurai.extra_description: Opens the Samurai tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

berzerker.title: Berzerker
berzerker.description: Pure aggression. Berzerkers stack raw attack damage, axe damage and life steal, hit more targets per swing and knock them flying. Fang Strike tears the ground open, Burning Dash and Stomp close the gap, Heartstop lets them ignore death for a few seconds, and Berserker and Forbidden Strength turn wounds into power. Key abilities: Fang Strike, Heartstop, Burning Dash, Stomp, Berserker, Forbidden Strength.
berzerker.extra_description: Opens the Berzerker tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

mage.title: Mage
mage.description: Spellcasting: mana, casting speed and arcane study.

holy.title: Holy
holy.description: A healer and support caster. Holy power strengthens light spells, healing received rises, and holy resistance protects against dark magic. Guiding Bolt, Heal, Greater Heal, Blessing of Life, Healing Circle, Cloud of Regeneration, Wisp, Cleanse, Sunbeam and Angel Wing keep a party alive, and Adaptive Skin hardens against whatever hurts you. Key abilities: Guiding Bolt, Heal, Blessing Of Life, Healing Circle, Sunbeam, Cloud Of Regeneration, Wisp, Cleanse, Angel Wing, Greater Heal, Adaptive Skin.
holy.extra_description: Opens the Holy tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

flame.title: Flame
flame.description: Burst damage and constant pressure. Fire power and cooldown reduction keep the flames coming, from Firebolt, Fire Breath and Scorch to Magma Bomb, Wall of Fire, Blaze Storm, Heat Surge, Fireball and Raise Hell, while ember skin resists fire and Vengeance burns back at whoever hurt you. Key abilities: Firebolt, Fire Breath, Magma Bomb, Heat Surge, Fireball, Scorch, Wall Of Fire, Blaze Storm, Raise Hell, Vengeance.
flame.extra_description: Opens the Flame tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

lightning.title: Lightning
lightning.description: A mobile storm caster. Lightning power grows, casting barely slows you down, and grounding resists shocks. Electrocute, Ball Lightning, Chain Lightning, Lightning Lance, Shockwave, Lightning Bolt and Thunderstorm punish anything in reach, while Charge, Volt Strike and Demolition Leap keep you moving. Key abilities: Electrocute, Ball Lightning, Chain Lightning, Lightning Lance, Lightning Bolt, Shockwave, Volt Strike, Charge, Thunderstorm, Demolition Leap.
lightning.extra_description: Opens the Lightning tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

necromancy.title: Necromancy
necromancy.description: Blood magic and the risen dead. Blood power and summon damage feed Wither Skull, Blood Slash, Blood Needles, Ray of Siphoning, Devour, Raise Dead, Summon Vex and Sacrifice, and Stamina Pillager feeds on every kill, turning every fight into a war of attrition. Key abilities: Wither Skull, Blood Slash, Ray Of Siphoning, Raise Dead, Devour, Blood Needles, Summon Vex, Sacrifice, Stamina Pillager.
necromancy.extra_description: Opens the Necromancy tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

ice.title: Ice
ice.description: Control and protection. Ice power, magic resistance and cold resistance back up Icicle, Cone of Cold, Ray of Frost, Frostwave, Frost Step, Ice Spikes, Ice Block, Frostbite and Blizzard, which slow, freeze and shatter anything that comes close. Hyper Vitality fuels weapon skills with stamina. Key abilities: Icicle, Cone Of Cold, Frost Step, Ice Spikes, Blizzard, Frostwave, Ray Of Frost, Ice Block, Frostbite, Hyper Vitality.
ice.extra_description: Opens the Ice tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

assassin.title: Assassin
assassin.description: Strike first, strike from behind. Daggers, backstab damage, armour negation and protection shred make every opening lethal. Echoing Strikes, Acupuncture and Bonebreaker punish a single target, while Blood Step and Invisibility get you in and out unseen. Key abilities: Echoing Strikes, Acupuncture, Bonebreaker, Blood Step, Invisibility.
assassin.extra_description: Opens the Assassin tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

phantom.title: Phantom
phantom.description: A rapier duellist built around the dodge. Rapiers (a sword with an empty off hand) grow sharper, dodges cost less stamina, and the first hit after a dodge lands as a riposte. Evasion turns incoming blows into blinks, Slow drags enemies down, Step replaces the roll with a sidestep and Catharsis charges the blade with every dodge. Key abilities: Evasion, Slow, Follow Up Kick, Don't You Have a Heart?, Step, Catharsis.
phantom.extra_description: Opens the Phantom tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

scout.title: Scout
scout.description: Speed, range and awareness. Scouts swim faster, break through terrain, resist ender magic and empower ender spells. Teleport, Haste, Gust, Phantom Ascent's mid-air jumps and Planar Sight let them reach, flee and see what others cannot. Key abilities: Teleport, Haste, Planar Sight, Gust, Phantom Ascent.
scout.extra_description: Opens the Scout tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

thief.title: Thief
thief.description: Luck and loot. Thieves gain luck, double drops, extra Fortune, longer reach and cheaper anvil repairs. Boogie Woogie claps swap places with creatures or blocks to confuse fights, Scapegoat and Firecracker cover a getaway, and Emergency Escape dodges out of any hit. Key abilities: Boogie Woogie, Block Clap, Scapegoat, Firecracker, Emergency Escape.
thief.extra_description: Opens the Thief tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

ranger.title: Ranger
ranger.description: The wilds: speed, agility, endurance and stranger arts.

wanderer.title: Wanderer
wanderer.description: Built for long journeys. Food lasts longer, mounts run faster, pets and horses hit harder and survive longer, and you step up full blocks. Summon Horse, Summon Polar Bear, Gluttony and Counterspell keep the road open, and Adrenaline Fiend gets you back on your feet after every kill. Key abilities: Summon Horse, Counterspell, Summon Polar Bear, Gluttony, Adrenaline Fiend.
wanderer.extra_description: Opens the Wanderer tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

stalker.title: Stalker
stalker.description: Bows and crossbows. Ranged damage, arrow and bolt speed and evocation power make every shot count. Arrow Volley rains arrows on a whole area, Poison Arrow leaves a lingering toxic cloud, Fire Arrow burns, and Revelation turns well-timed defence into a stunning counter. Key abilities: Arrow Volley, Poison Arrow, Fire Arrow, Revelation.
stalker.extra_description: Opens the Stalker tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

druid.title: Druid
druid.description: Nature magic and the land's healing. Nature power and resistance strengthen Acid Orb, Root, Firefly Swarm, Blight, Poison Splash, Spider Aspect, Oakskin and Earthquake, Meteor Slam brings the sky down, and standing on natural ground slowly heals you. Key abilities: Acid Orb, Root, Firefly Swarm, Earthquake, Oakskin, Blight, Poison Splash, Spider Aspect, Meteor Slam.
druid.extra_description: Opens the Druid tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.

cursed.title: Cursed
cursed.description: Cursed techniques fuelled by mana instead of cursed energy, with no cooldowns. Dismantle and Cleave cut enemies apart, and the Malevolent Shrine domain, closed and then open, shreds everything around you while you keep cutting. Cursed Control makes techniques cheaper; melee resistance and toughness shred round it out, with Swordmaster and Death Harvest for the blade. Key abilities: Dismantle, Cleave, Malevolent Shrine, Malevolent Shrine: Open, Swordmaster, Death Harvest, Soul Hunt.
cursed.extra_description: Opens the Cursed tab. You can pick 2 archetypes in total.
